row.evidence: Braintree's SCIM guide says onboarding requires that "You are a managed merchant (ie, you have a dedicated CSM or TAM). We are not currently onboarding unmanaged merchants to SCIM."
row.notes: New row. Braintree is priced per transaction (standard rate 2.89% + $0.29; custom and interchange-plus pricing for established businesses), with no per-user tiers, so all per-user fields are null. SCIM (Okta via the Braintree OIN app, Entra ID via a non-gallery app with tenant URL https://id.braintreegateway.com/scim and a Braintree-issued bearer token) is only for managed merchants with a dedicated CSM/TAM, so it sits behind a sales relationship (gated). Prerequisites: SSO onboarded on both sandbox and production merchants, users converted to SSO; only SSO users are SCIM-managed and, once on SCIM, SSO users can no longer be created or edited in the Control Panel. Supports user create/get/update/delete and group (role, merchant-account, grant-all, API-access) membership updates; groups/roles cannot be created or deleted over SCIM. Okta deactivation suspends the user; deleting SSO users is not possible through Okta. SAML SSO is set up on request via CSM/TAM or Braintree support (plan gate not stated). No user-management API in the Braintree payments API.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Transaction pricing; SSO is set up on request (c21), plan gate not stated. SCIM needs a managed merchant (dedicated CSM/TAM).

plans.name: Custom pricing
plans.price_text: Custom flat rate / interchange plus (Contact Sales)
plans.notes: Managed-merchant status (dedicated CSM/TAM) is the SCIM gate, not a named plan.

auth.token_source: Issued by Braintree (CSM/TAM / Braintree Identity team) during SCIM onboarding

operations.notes: Groups (roles, merchant accounts, grant-all, API access) are imported to Okta and linked as push groups; only membership is updated. Delete is not possible from Okta. HTTP verbs are not documented.

custom.how: Other attributes break provisioning and must be removed (Entra guide)

roles.how: Group membership: each Braintree role and merchant account is an Okta app group linked as a push group

limitations.text: Only managed merchants (dedicated CSM/TAM) are onboarded to SCIM; a sandbox merchant must be onboarded first.
Only SSO users can be SCIM users; non-SSO users stay managed in the Control Panel, and SSO users cannot be created or edited there once on SCIM.
Roles and merchant accounts cannot be created, deleted or renamed over SCIM; SSO users cannot be deleted via Okta.
Role / merchant-account group management is documented for Okta only; Entra guide covers users only.
Okta setup requires the Braintree OIN app instance for SSO.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Audit Webhooks (API key, tokenization key, IP restriction and 2FA changes) are only available to select partners.

user_api.notes: Control Panel users are created in Team settings; no user-management endpoints in the Braintree payments API reference. 'false' is by absence.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push; Braintree calls it 'our OIN application'.

entra.notes: No gallery tutorial (braintree-tutorial 404); Braintree documents a non-gallery app with SAML and SCIM.

onelogin.notes: Braintree says to build a custom SCIM app per the IdP's own guide.

fallbacks.notes: Without SCIM, SSO users must still be created in the Control Panel (no JIT).
